newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-NO DECISION YET TO BID FOR AEK SAYS YRANITSAS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NO DECISION YET TO BID FOR AEK SAYS YRANITSAS.

text.p: Yiannis Yranitsas, the deputy general manager of dairy FAGE, said no decision had been reached yet as to whether Yannis Fillipou, major shareholder of FAGE and VIS , would submit a bid to buy the AEK soccer club.
"We have reached no decision yet as to whether we would submit a bid to buy AEK," Yranitsas told Reuters. "We will decide in the next few days."
Michalis Trohanas, the president of SOE company that has a majority stake in AEK, invited prospective investors to submit bids to buy SOE's stake in AEK by Wednesday.
Trohanas has asked for a minimum of 1.2 billion drachmas plus a two-year interest.
Yranitsas, who is the right-hand man of AEK's basketball club Fillipou, said he did not regard the deadline as an obstacle for submitting a proposal.
AEK won Greece's cup winners' cup for 1997 in April. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
